purpose: Rounded-frame revision of the proposed Mini-Orca UI mockups, following the user's attached visual reference. Visual concepts only.

concepts.name: 01-summary-rounded
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Edit image 1, the user's approved Mini-Orca design concept. Image 2 is a style reference ONLY for its rounded inset workspace panes and softly colored outer frame. The user specifically wants the app border/frame like image 2 and less square. Deliver one finished full-size landscape desktop UI mockup at the same aspect ratio as image 1, with crisp readable existing text. Maintain every functional element, content, datum, status, action, and overall information hierarchy from image 1 except the minor explicitly named corrections below. This is a targeted visual revision, not a redesign.
Most important change: make large workspace panes visibly ROUND at all four corners, inset within a continuous muted charcoal-teal app frame matching image 2. Shape guidance: app outer corners about 22px; major workspace panes about 18px radius; 8px visible gutters between structural panes; 8px inset below the top bar and before footer, with continuous outer chrome visible. Keep rounded corners small and sophisticated at this scale, not exaggerated or pill-like. Make the silhouette obviously softer than image 1. Keep full UI inside the image, no clipping, no perspective, no laptop, no external captions or surrounding scene.
Keep Mini-Orca branding, project go-shop, main branch, search, six rail icons, daemon status and analysis status, and bottom model counts in their current roles. Do not copy melotrail, codex/terra-live, .gradle, or any text or controls from image 2. No new functionality.
Treat the top bar, icon rail and bottom footer as one unified quiet charcoal frame with a very subtle desaturated teal tint like image 2. Interior work canvas remains nearly black #1B1E23, pane surfaces #24282F. Keep text contrast. Replace hard bright perimeter strokes with separation through the 8px gutters and extremely subtle boundary contrast. No heavy white outlines, shadows, bevels, glossy gradients or glow. Preserve calm blue action accents and semantic state colors. Existing internal components remain compact with about 10px button and 12px card corners. Do not turn every table row or text section into an additional card. Preserve straight internal separators and dense professional developer-tool alignment.
Every pane's header fill, selection and footer must clip cleanly to that pane's rounded perimeter. No layer may extend as a square slab across a round corner. Roundedness should be strongest on structural panes and window silhouette, like the reference. Keep small muted concept/example-data labeling.
SPECIFIC SUMMARY GEOMETRY: The entire Summary workspace, including its title and cards, is ONE large rounded dark panel inset beneath the top bar, right of the left rail, and above the footer. Keep all summary content and the two-column lower layout within it. Existing coverage and metric cards stay neatly aligned. Set the FIRST rail icon (document/Summary) active and leave the SECOND chart/Analysis icon inactive, correcting the base mockup's mismatch. Make the Security "Not analyzed" card neutral slate rather than green, retaining its em dash and exact label. Remove only the redundant two-line placeholder "No diagram shown. Expand to view the request flows." from Flows; retain its Show diagram button. These minor corrections aside, preserve all content and layout. Add small existing-style label "Concept 01 · Rounded frame · Example data".
